unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I'll call you again later when I arrive.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: wh开头的疑问词，when（当……时）问时间。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What are you going to do while I'm away?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: while有i-e发音结构，中间夹着l，表示一段时间。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Before you go, there's something I want to ask you.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: be（在……）+ fore（前方），在前面就是“在……之前”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Can I have the newspaper when you've finished with it?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“阿爸特”，爸爸特意安排在事情发生之后。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Wait here until I come back.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: un（不）+ til（直到），一直不走直到……

unit_vocabulary.comparison: as soon as vs as long as
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I'll come as soon as I finish.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: as（像）soon（快）as（一样），越快越好，即“一……就……”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Can I have the newspaper when you've finished with it?
Hurry up! If we don't hurry, we'll be late.
Vicky will be very disappointed if she doesn't get a place at university.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: dis（否定）+ appoint（约定/任命）= 愿望落空，很失望。
做错了事，向对方说声“阿婆捞汁”来道歉。
